g.title: defi-adapter
g.text: Detects positions across Blend · Aquarius · Soroswap · Phoenix · FxDAO via OctoPos

g.title: cluster_normalize
g.text: Adapter maps provider shapes to one internal model

g.title: cluster_degraded
g.text: OctoPos unavailable or data too stale

g.title: req
g.text: Triggered when user submits address for analysis

g.title: testnet_path
g.text: Reads DeFi state directly via RPC getLedgerEntries + contract registry
(same code path as degraded mode -> always exercised in CI)

g.title: octo
g.text: Sends only the account address · no user identity stored

g.title: plan_ready
g.text: Each position becomes one or more exit steps

g.title: degraded
g.text: Trustlines · offers · data entries proceed normally

g.title: refresh
g.text: Signal OctoPos to re-index this address

g.title: normalize
g.text: Enriched with asset symbols · USD prices · contract names and versions

g.title: meta
g.text: Low attribution_confidence -> show notice to verify on explorer

g.title: warn
g.text: DeFi positions could not be detected
User advised to verify Blend · Aquarius · Soroswap · Phoenix · FxDAO manually
